title: Gratitude Log Cadence by Day of Week
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:log
| eval day=strftime(_time,"%A")
| stats count as entries, avg(item_count) as avg_items by day
| sort day
description: Shows which days of the week you are most and least likely to pause and note something positive.
value: A cadence view often reveals that gratitude is easy on calm days and forgotten on overloaded ones.
implementation: Send gratitude logs with item counts to `index=personal`; summarize entries and average list size by weekday.
visualization: Weekday table of gratitude entry counts and average items listed.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which days of the week you tend to remember gratitude and which busy days make it disappear.
